recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-7885 unless a future Patient Care decision explicitly changes Goal.start[x] types or adds dateTime support.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Patient Care request from the DSTU1 cycle to add Goal.startDate for goals that begin after a later date or event. The final Jira resolution says the request was resolved as part of FHIR-8488.
initial_application: FHIR-7885 and FHIR-8488 both cite SVN #6806. The corresponding git-svn commit 8bd3bd917d537625fad908b5f0f6277d113b941e, 'Goal tracker items', added Goal.start[x] with date and CodeableConcept choices, a GoalStartEvent binding, and related target timing changes; later source refactors preserved that model in source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Goal as an active resource. Current source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml defines Goal.start[x] as 0..1, summary, date and CodeableConcept, with the requested 'date or event after which the goal should begin being pursued' definition. In FHIR choice serialization, the date choice is startDate. FHIR-12400 later added the separate Goal start-date search parameter, which is also present. Community searches found no conflicting decision; a later Patient Care Zulip thread about dateTime concluded a time component was not needed and produced no final Jira change.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Adding a separate Goal.startDate element would duplicate the existing choice element, and narrowing Goal.start[x] to date-only would lose the event-based CodeableConcept approved in FHIR-8488.

related_jiras.note: Broader Published Goal presentation issue whose resolution explicitly supplied the applied start[x] date-or-event model for FHIR-7885.
Separate Published DSTU2 issue that added the Goal start-date search parameter after Goal.start[x] existed; current source already includes it.
